topOpportunities.opportunity: Port Pavilion at Broadway Pier — Preferred Lodging Partnership
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Port Pavilion at Broadway Pier is ~0.4 mi from Wyndham San Diego Bayside on the same Harbor Drive / Embarcadero spine. Port facility has no lodging inventory; public pages do not name an exclusive preferred hotel — complementary overnight referral remains open. Marketing copy is not evidence of confirmed room nights.
topOpportunities.whyNow: Port publishes Port Pavilion as a standing rental venue for private/corporate functions; partnership path is ongoing, not a dated citywide block.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Email portpavilion@portofsandiego.org to ask how organizers source overnight lodging for Pavilion events and whether Wyndham Bayside can be listed as a nearby option.

topOpportunities.whyHotel: Independent downtown venue (~1.2 mi from Wyndham Bayside) has no lodging inventory. Nearby full-service hotels (including Marriott Bayfront) compete for overnight guests — Wyndham remains a plausible alternate for overflow/referral. Venue marketing pages are not proof of confirmed room demand.
topOpportunities.whyNow: The Lane publishes ongoing private social and wedding rentals with a direct venue inquiry email; standing partnership path.

contactPath.provenanceNote: Email is an organization contact path; it is not confirmed as The Lane's personal address.

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Email info@thelanevenue.com to introduce Wyndham San Diego Bayside as a nearby Harbor Drive overnight option for The Lane private-event guests.

topOpportunities.opportunity: Embarcadero Marina Park South — Preferred Lodging Partnership
topOpportunities.whyHotel: EMPS sits on the downtown waterfront corridor with Wyndham San Diego Bayside. Permitted gatherings have no on-site rooms.
topOpportunities.whyNow: Port of San Diego publishes park permitting for organized gatherings; EMPS is a standing venue account, not a single dated room block.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Email parkpermits@portofsandiego.org to ask which organizers repeatedly host EMPS events needing downtown lodging.

topOpportunities.opportunity: Maritime Museum of San Diego — Preferred Lodging Partnership
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Maritime Museum sits on the Embarcadero within walking distance of Wyndham San Diego Bayside (1355 N Harbor Drive). Guests for vessel private events need nearby overnight rooms; no exclusive preferred-lodging partner identified on public events pages — leaving a bayfront referral opening. Venue marketing does not prove confirmed room demand.
topOpportunities.whyNow: Museum publishes ongoing special-events / private-function rentals on museum vessels; standing partnership path, not a single dated room block.

contactPath.provenanceNote: Email is an organization contact path; it is not confirmed as Maritime Museum of San Diego's personal address.

topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Email events.mmsd@gmail.com or specialevents@sdmaritime.org to ask how planners currently source overnight lodging and whether Wyndham Bayside can be offered as a nearby option.

topOpportunities.opportunity: USS Midway Museum — Preferred Lodging Partnership
topOpportunities.whyHotel: Wyndham San Diego Bayside sits in the same North Harbor corridor as Midway. Venue guests need nearby overnight rooms; published F&B partners are competing hotels for catering, not exclusive lodging.
topOpportunities.whyNow: Official Midway evening-events program (6–10 p.m.) for recurring private functions; lodging referral is ongoing, not a single dated room block.
topOpportunities.recommendedAction: Use Midway evening-events inquiry path and museum contact 619-544-9600 to ask how planners source overnight lodging and whether Wyndham Bayside can be listed as a nearby option.
